collection.description: Visitors urge the village to grow one profitable crop instead of many: try it, or keep the village's mix of crops.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Traders have promised to buy every basket of sweet yellow root the village can grow, and pay well, if the village plants nothing else. (subject) says the village could be rich. (friend) says one crop means one blight away from hunger. The village wants its leaders to ask every family before deciding. What should the village choose?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village plants half its gardens with sweet yellow root. The traders pay well. Then a blight hits the root. The other half of the gardens feed everyone, barely. (subject) agrees that half was the right amount.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village keeps its many crops. The traders leave disappointed. The village is not rich. It is fed, every season, whatever the weather.
